image_file and save_original_as accept absolute paths or paths relative to the user home directory. Height and width are documented as positive pixel dimensions; the client forwards integers without adding range validation. The result is the absolute resized image path as a string.

Omitting saveOriginalAs (including null) omits save_original_as and the server does not save a copy of the original. Explicit empty string is sent. The pinned save_original_as description calls it a directory, while its example images/original.jpg looks file-like; the client forwards it unchanged without resolving that discrepancy or performing a local filesystem operation.
